gloss: to establish, to set, to determine

definitions.gloss: to establish, to set, to stipulate
definitions.explanation: To formally decide on rules, standards, laws, or criteria. Often used in legal, regulatory, or official contexts.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}で{定|さだ}める。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{規則|きそく}を{定|さだ}めた。
この{地域|ちいき}は{条例|じょうれい}で{建物|たてもの}の{高|たか}さを{定|さだ}めている。
examples.english: This area has set building heights by ordinance.

notes:
{定|さだ}める is formal and used in official/legal contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Intransitive pair: {定|さだ}まる (to be established, to be decided)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法律|ほうりつ}で{定|さだ}める: to stipulate by law
- {基準|きじゅん}を{定|さだ}める: to set standards
- {規則|きそく}を{定|さだ}める: to establish rules
- {目標|もくひょう}を{定|さだ}める: to set a goal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定|さだ}める: to establish, stipulate (formal, official)
- {決|き}める: to decide (general, everyday)
